# crds/gateway-api-crds.yaml | GitRepository flux-system/gateway-api
# serves v1 only -- v1alpha2 is present with served: false -- so the API server
# still 404s and the informer still hangs. Only experimental serves v1alpha2
# alongside v1.
#
# This is not a stability trade for the resources actually in use: experimental

# crds/gateway-api-crds.yaml | GitRepository flux-system/gateway-api
# This is not a stability trade for the resources actually in use: experimental
# is a superset of standard, and Gateway, HTTPRoute, GRPCRoute and
# ReferenceGrant are the same GA v1 types in both channels. It adds the alpha
# CRDs and some extra optional fields.

# crds/gateway-api-crds.yaml | GitRepository flux-system/gateway-api
# CRDs and some extra optional fields.
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: gateway-api
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1h
  url: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api
  ref:
    tag: v1.6.2

# crds/gateway-api-crds.yaml | GitRepository flux-system/gateway-api
    tag: v1.6.2
  # Both channels are fetched even though only one is applied. The artifact is
  # keyed on the git revision, so narrowing this to a single channel means a
  # channel switch changes nothing source-controller notices: it keeps the old

# crds/gateway-api-crds.yaml | GitRepository flux-system/gateway-api
  # channel switch changes nothing source-controller notices: it keeps the old
  # artifact and the Kustomization below fails with "kustomization path not
  # found". Keeping /config/crd whole makes the path the only thing that moves.
  ignore: |
    /*
    !/config/crd/

# crds/gateway-api-crds.yaml | Kustomization flux-system/gateway-api-crds
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: gateway-api-crds
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1h
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: gateway-api
  path: ./config/crd/experimental
  prune: true
  wait: true
